executiveSummary: HES A COMPLETE. Current system evaluates export readiness per-site (site selection mandatory, per-site UI/API). Classification attributes (category/class/department) are NOT enforced despite being marked required_for_completion=true in registry (likely due to segment config excluding classification category). Target design: Add 'mode' field (GLOBAL/SITE_SCOPED), productLevelReadiness object for RetailOps, preserve siteStatus[] for other tenants. Migration: 5-phase rollout with instant rollback. All evidence files delivered. Runtime API evidence blocked (no staging credentials). Design and migration plan ready for HES B approval.

commandsRun: jq '[.attributes[] | select(.required_for_completion == true) | {attribute_id, category, source: "SDK registry"}]' packages/sdk/config/attributeRegistry.json > evidence/lp-export-global-1.0.0/required-attributes-completion.json

jq '[.attributes[] | select(.required_for_export == true) | {attribute_id, category, source: "SDK registry"}]' packages/sdk/config/attributeRegistry.json > evidence/lp-export-global-1.0.0/required-attributes-export.json

jq '[.attributes[] | select(.required_for_completion == true or .required_for_export == true) | {attribute_id, required_for_completion, required_for_export, category}]' packages/sdk/config/attributeRegistry.json > evidence/lp-export-global-1.0.0/required-attributes-combined.json
grep -rn 'siteStatus' packages/web/src/ (searched for UI decision points)
grep -rn 'extractSelectedSites' packages/api/src/services/ (searched for server gating logic)
